summary: Firefox strengthened communication between browser processes by validating principals, origins, window IDs, scopes, postMessage sources, file-picker inputs, and blob URL registrations before accepting requests. It also introduced clearer process types, a dedicated hardware-inference utility process, and a new IPC path for speech-recognition model availability. Accessibility objects now follow window lifecycles more safely, while navigation, session history, drag-and-drop, and process shutdown handling avoid unnecessary work and crashes.
